IS 8093 : 2025 ENT Surgery Instruments - Curette - Ballance's Pattern - Specification
ICS 11.040.30
ICS 11.040.30
MHD 04
MHD 04
1 SCOPE
This standard covers dimensional and other requirement of Ballance's pattern double-ended curette fenestrated with scoop used in ENT surgery.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
